art: Silkscreen board art: deep solder-mask green ground, copper-tone traces and pads, crisp white silkscreen outlines, precise geometric routing with right-angle and 45-degree turns. Flat and printed-looking — no photographic gloss or reflections.

background.css: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(232,163,79,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(232,163,79,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px), radial-gradient(circle at 30% 0%, #123020 0%, #0d2418 55%, #081a10 100%)

mood: A printed circuit board under a bench lamp: deep solder-mask green ground with a faint copper routing grid, silkscreen-white lettering, copper the only metal. Signatures to reproduce structurally: (1) card and aside borders are 1px copper (--accent) hairlines with a small filled 'via' dot at each corner (pseudo-elements or radial-gradient corners) — components soldered onto the board; (2) section headings carry a silkscreen reference designator in mono before the title (U1, R2, J3 …) in --ink-soft small caps; (3) connecting rules between diagram elements are right-angled traces, never curves — copper lines with rounded pads at the ends; (4) code blocks sit on the darkest green (--code-bg) like epoxy windows into the board. Copper is spent on borders, key terms, and headings; green stays calm and matte, no glow. The feel: hardware-shop precision — the book as a beautifully routed board.

tagline: Solder-mask green + copper traces — silkscreen precision
